notes.title: PATCH 0.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41130298/c27519a28dc1c18cea0e4b355a53ae6413b60d44.png[/img]

Hi guys, 

Today we have a huge update for you. 
We hope you like the result of our work over the last few weeks. 

[list]
[*] added a story intro 
[*] implemented new settings (sound, graphics)
[*] implemented new HUD and Menu design
[*] reworked camera position
[*] reworked the tutorials
[*] implemented controller support
[*] added new state - Element power
[*] added new element attack - water arrows
[*] reworked questline
[*] reworked lightsetup
[*] added new accessoires and armor

[*] localisation fixes
[*] design, collision and bug fixes
[*] quality of life changes
[/list]

We hope you enjoy playing!

Your inAntrum Dev-Team

notes.title: Patchnotes
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
until now we didn't manage to write patch notes for our updates. We would like to make up for that, because we have added a few things to the demo recently. So if you haven't played for a while, you are welcome to take another glance.
We hope you had fun with the demo so far. More content will follow in the next months!
